title: Unified defense for large language models against jailbreak and fine-tuning attacks in education
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical defense framework (TSSF) and a safety benchmark (EduHarm) for educational LLMs to mitigate jailbreak and fine-tuning attacks. While the benchmark rules are derived from educational ethics policies, the paper is centered on safety alignment and adversarial defense rather than the evaluation of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical philosophy.
